method.strategy_a: Original semantic retrieval plus one websearch OR query containing the original query and ontology/data-supported phrase substitutions.
method.strategy_b: Strategy A plus an independently embedded canonical semantic query; original and canonical semantic ranks are fused deterministically before normal hybrid RRF.
method.strategy_b_trigger: Test only when Strategy A fully resolves fewer than 13/25 affected queries or recovers fewer than 168/336 missing cases.
method.query_normalization: Deterministic longest non-overlapping phrase matching; ambiguous aliases skipped; exact identities no-op; original query always retained.

decision.rationale: No experimental strategy met the predeclared minimum recovery, quality non-regression, and safety gates.
